newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine coconut oil prices seen in range.
newsitem.headline: Philippine coconut oil prices seen in range.

text.p: Philippine coconut oil prices are expected to move in a range this week, reflecting a dearth of news, traders said on Monday.
"I expect prices to move within the $10 to $15 range," a trader with one of the country's largest coconut oil millers said.
"There's not enough earth-shaking fundamentals which could sway the market either up or down," said a broker in Manila.
The trade group United Coconut Associations of the Philippines Inc said coconut oil exports reached 67,757 tonnes from October 1 to 24.
Philippine traders placed monthly average coconut oil exports at 66,800 tonnes from January to September this year.
"There's a little improvement in local copra supply, but not much to affect fundamentals," said one trader.
Traders said news that Malaysia had forged a joint venture with a Philippine firm to set up coconut oil mills in the southern Philippines would not have any impact on the market in the short term.
Malaysia's state of Terengganu plans to invest six billion pesos in the joint venture with Philippine-based Janoub Philippines Development Corp, officials from both countries said on Friday.
The officials also said the project included the development of 55,000 hectares of palm farms in southern provinces of Lanao del Sur, Tawi-tawi and Maguindanao.
Traders said coconut oil sellers quoted $725 per tonne CIF for October/November shipment on Monday while buyers quoted $715.
